podcast.title: Renowned Gospel Act
podcast.body: The Sensational Nightingales were recognized as "one of the best gospel acts on the circuit" during their time. "The Sensational Nightingales, who were one of the best gospel acts on the circuit."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Secular Songwriting for Others
podcast.body: Despite being a prominent gospel group, they wrote a secular song called "The Twist." They actively sought another group to perform it because their religious affiliation prevented them from recording or performing it themselves. "They couldn't sing it themselves. It was a secular song, and they were a gospel group, but they knew that it could be a success if someone did."
